color.name: color-purple-100
color.usage: Accent tint. Hover layer for accent outlined/basic buttons (components-accent-outlined_basic-hover).

color.name: color-purple-400
color.usage: Brand purple. Brand icons only (icon-brand); 3:1+ on white, not for text.

color.name: color-purple-600
color.usage: Accent purple. Accent filled buttons, FABs, chips and accent icons; text-invert on it.

color.name: color-neutral-0
color.usage: White. Primary surface; inverse text, icons and borders on surface-invert.

color.name: color-neutral-50
color.usage: Lightest grey. Very quiet surfaces (surface-minimal-light).

color.name: color-neutral-100

color.name: color-neutral-200
color.usage: Light grey. Contrast surfaces, secondary borders, dividers, disabled fills.

color.name: color-neutral-400

color.name: color-neutral-600
color.usage: Dark grey. Secondary text and icons; footer text; tooltip container.

color.name: color-neutral-800
color.usage: Ink. Primary text and icons; primary filled buttons; header bar (surface-invert).

color.name: color-neutral-1000
color.usage: Black. Primary button hover background.

color.name: color-red-100
color.usage: Negative tint. Negative surfaces and light negative fills.

color.name: color-red-500
color.usage: Negative. Error text, negative buttons, input error borders.

color.name: color-red-900
color.usage: Negative ink. Text and icons on red-100.

color.name: color-yellow-100
color.usage: Warn tint. Warn surfaces and chips.

color.name: color-yellow-500
color.usage: Warn. Defined in primitives; no semantic token maps to it.

color.name: color-yellow-900
color.usage: Warn ink. Warn text and icons on yellow-100.

color.name: color-green-100
color.usage: Positive tint. Positive surfaces and chips.

color.name: color-green-500

color.name: color-green-900
color.usage: Positive ink. Positive text and icons on green-100.

color.name: color-blue-100

color.name: color-blue-500
color.usage: Info. Defined in primitives; no semantic token maps to it.

color.name: color-blue-900
color.usage: Info ink. Info text and icons on blue-100.

color.name: surface-primary
color.usage: Default page and container background (cards, menus, dialogs, tooltips).

color.name: surface-minimal
color.usage: Quiet background: table headers, button-toggle container, filled inputs.

color.name: surface-minimal-light
color.usage: Quieter than surface-minimal: subtle zebra rows and wells.

color.name: surface-contrast
color.usage: Stronger grey ground; dividers and progress-bar tracks.

color.name: surface-invert
color.usage: Dark ground: the global header bar and inverted tabs. Pair with text-invert.

color.name: surface-info
color.usage: Info notification/chip background. Pair with text-info.

color.name: surface-positive
color.usage: Positive notification/chip background. Pair with text-positive.

color.name: surface-negative
color.usage: Negative (warn-severity) notification background. Pair with color-red-900 (12.8:1); text-negative on it is 4.25:1, so keep red action labels at label weight or larger.

color.name: surface-warn
color.usage: Warn chip background. Pair with text-warn.

color.name: text-primary

color.name: text-secondary
color.usage: Supporting copy and footer text on surface-primary and surface-minimal.

color.name: text-invert

color.name: border-primary
color.usage: Default control outlines and inline-notification rule. ~1.9:1 on white: below the 3:1 non-text floor in the source.

color.name: border-invert
